rca of the issue: Root cause: Companies House bulk loader (vbie_connectors.upsert_candidates) previously wrote buyer docs without checking contact fields → ~900 UK buyers with no email/phone were inserted → subscriber reveal returned empty contact. Fix (verified this iteration): (1) upsert_candidates now calls has_contact(contact) and skips rows without email/phone, counting them as skipped_no_contact, and stamps has_contact:True on every insert; (2) run_ingestion enforces the same rule; (3) /api/buyers/search and /api/buyers/meta both filter has_contact:True so leaked docs (if any) are never surfaced. Verified all 20 spot-checked buyers (incl. GB) reveal a non-empty email or phone as vaibhav.
